description: This Java class provides methods to retrieve a list of ECU ROM inheritance nodes from an XML DOM document and ECU definition, including methods to get base ROM IDs and corresponding nodes using XPath.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionInheritanceList
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving ECU ROM inheritance nodes from XML documents.

methods.name: getInheritanceList
methods.description: Returns a list of ROM inheritance nodes starting from the given ECU definition back to the base.

methods.name: getBaseRomId
methods.description: Retrieves the CAL ID of the base ROM for a given CAL ID using XPath.

methods.name: getBaseRomIdNode
methods.description: Retrieves the 'rom' Node element that contains the specified CAL ID.
